scenarios.name: Press Enter after moving the template folder highlight with Up

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project
the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders
the catalog root has no direct template files

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder and its grouped templates
the details pane identifies the selected Standard (mm) part template
the user clicks the Metric folder in the folder tree
the English folder is highlighted in the tree
the metric template gallery remains visible
the details pane still identifies Standard (mm)
the chooser closes and a new empty part becomes active
a new document tab appears alongside the original part
the user closes the new unedited part
